cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(sprintz_standalone VERSION 1.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden)
set(CMAKE_C_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden)
set(CMAKE_VISIBILITY_INLINES_HIDDEN YES)
option(SZ_FUZZ "Clang libFuzzer" OFF)
if(SZ_FUZZ)
 add_compile_options(-fsanitize=fuzzer-no-link)
endif()
option(SZ_SANITIZE "ASan UBSan" OFF)
option(SZ_TSAN "TSan" OFF)
set(SZ_CORE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/vendor/core" CACHE PATH "Frozen or patched core")
if(SZ_SANITIZE)
 add_compile_options(-fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer -fno-sanitize-recover=all)
 add_link_options(-fsanitize=address,undefined)
endif()
if(SZ_TSAN)
 add_compile_options(-fsanitize=thread -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
 add_link_options(-fsanitize=thread)
endif()
set(CORE_FILES sprintz.cpp format.cpp sprintz_delta.cpp sprintz_delta_rle.cpp sprintz_delta_lowdim.cpp sprintz_xff.cpp sprintz_xff_rle.cpp sprintz_xff_lowdim.cpp delta.cpp predict.cpp univariate_8b.cpp)
list(TRANSFORM CORE_FILES PREPEND "${SZ_CORE}/")
add_library(sz_native OBJECT ${CORE_FILES})
target_include_directories(sz_native PUBLIC ${SZ_CORE} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src)
target_compile_options(sz_native PRIVATE -mavx2 -mbmi -mbmi2 -mlzcnt -mpopcnt -fno-strict-aliasing)
set(HUFF vendor/huff0/lib)
add_library(sz_huff OBJECT ${HUFF}/common/entropy_common.c ${HUFF}/common/fse_decompress.c ${HUFF}/common/error_private.c ${HUFF}/compress/huf_compress.c ${HUFF}/compress/fse_compress.c ${HUFF}/compress/hist.c ${HUFF}/decompress/huf_decompress.c)
target_include_directories(sz_huff PUBLIC ${HUFF}/common ${HUFF}/compress ${HUFF})
add_library(sz_dispatch OBJECT src/native_dispatch.cpp)
target_include_directories(sz_dispatch PRIVATE src tools ${SZ_CORE})
target_compile_options(sz_dispatch PRIVATE -mavx2 -mbmi -mbmi2 -mlzcnt -mpopcnt -fno-strict-aliasing)
add_executable(sprintz_oracle tools/native_cli.cpp tools/source_huff.cpp)
target_include_directories(sprintz_oracle PRIVATE tools)
target_compile_options(sprintz_oracle PRIVATE -mavx2 -mbmi -mbmi2 -mlzcnt -mpopcnt -fno-strict-aliasing)
target_link_libraries(sprintz_oracle PRIVATE sz_native sz_huff)
option(SZ_QUERY_DIAGNOSTIC "Build experimental pushed-down query probe" OFF)
if(SZ_QUERY_DIAGNOSTIC)
 add_executable(sprintz_query_probe tools/query_probe.cpp ${SZ_CORE}/sprintz_delta_rle_query.cpp ${SZ_CORE}/sprintz_xff_rle_query.cpp)
 target_link_libraries(sprintz_query_probe PRIVATE sz_native)
 target_compile_options(sprintz_query_probe PRIVATE -mavx2 -mbmi -mbmi2 -mlzcnt -mpopcnt -fno-strict-aliasing)
endif()
add_executable(sprintz_experiments tools/experiments.cpp)
 target_link_libraries(sprintz_experiments PRIVATE sz_native)
 target_compile_options(sprintz_experiments PRIVATE -mavx2 -mbmi -mbmi2 -mlzcnt -mpopcnt -fno-strict-aliasing)
if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/api.cpp")
 add_library(sprintz SHARED src/api.cpp $<TARGET_OBJECTS:sz_dispatch>)
 target_include_directories(sprintz PUBLIC $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include> $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include> PRIVATE tools)
 target_link_libraries(sprintz PRIVATE sz_native sz_huff)
 add_library(sprintz_static STATIC src/api.cpp $<TARGET_OBJECTS:sz_native> $<TARGET_OBJECTS:sz_huff> $<TARGET_OBJECTS:sz_dispatch>)
 target_include_directories(sprintz_static PUBLIC $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include> $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include> PRIVATE tools src ${SZ_CORE} ${HUFF}/common)
 add_executable(sprintz_cli tools/cli.cpp)
 target_link_libraries(sprintz_cli PRIVATE sprintz)
 add_executable(sprintz_tests tests/test_api.cpp)
 target_link_libraries(sprintz_tests PRIVATE sprintz pthread)
 add_executable(sprintz_negative tests/test_negative.cpp)
 target_link_libraries(sprintz_negative PRIVATE sprintz pthread)
 if(SZ_FUZZ)
  add_executable(sprintz_fuzz tests/fuzz_decode.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(sprintz_fuzz PRIVATE sprintz)
  target_link_options(sprintz_fuzz PRIVATE -fsanitize=fuzzer)
 endif()
 enable_testing()
 add_test(NAME negative COMMAND sprintz_negative)
 add_test(NAME api COMMAND sprintz_tests)
 install(TARGETS sprintz sprintz_static sprintz_cli LIBRARY DESTINATION lib ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
 install(FILES include/sprintz_port.h DESTINATION include)
endif()
